hypothesis: After an extreme funding imbalance, a direction-confirming price move accompanied by open-interest rebuilding predicts a cost-positive continuation over the next 24 hours.

universe.rule: exact frozen strict-complete 20 from the 2026-10-28 list-only probe; every symbol must pass OI-LOADER-01 for the full requested interval or the evaluation refuses

causality.price_signal_source: the last fully closed 15m Binance UM kline
causality.execution: next 15m bar open after the decision; if unavailable, skip

signal.long: latest available funding <= its trailing 270-event 10th percentile; current available OI is at least 0.5% above the minimum available OI in the prior 360 minutes; last closed 15m return > 0
signal.short: latest available funding >= its trailing 270-event 90th percentile; current available OI is at least 0.5% above the minimum available OI in the prior 360 minutes; last closed 15m return < 0
signal.ties: quantile equality qualifies; zero price return does not
signal.warmup: no decision until all fixed lookbacks are complete and observed
signal.repeat_entry: at most one entry per symbol and funding-event identity; no pyramiding

portfolio.ranking_when_capacity_bound: descending absolute distance of funding from its trailing median; symbol ascending as deterministic tie-break
portfolio.exit: first of protective stop, opposite-side signal, or 24h after entry
portfolio.overnight_and_funding: positions remain open; every causally due funding cashflow is booked

costs.funding: actual causally available Binance funding cashflows with the exchange sign convention

claims.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni family-wise alpha 0.05 across combined, long and short claims
claims.bootstrap: stationary bootstrap of UTC daily net returns, 10000 resamples, deterministic seed 20261101, mean block length 7 days

validation_gates.directional_promotion: a side is eligible only if its Holm-adjusted claim passes, it has >=40 completed trades, positive net return and profit factor >=1.05; a failing side stays disabled even when combined passes

hard_stop.before_holdout: any admission, causal-parity, validation, multiplicity, concentration, activity or 1.5x-cost gate failure => FAIL; do not open holdout
hard_stop.after_holdout: any holdout gate failure => FAIL / NO PAPER
hard_stop.after_failure: record rejection; no tuning on development, validation or holdout results; any changed design requires a new candidate id and trial-budget entry

required_outputs: fees, slippage and funding by trade
explicit PASS or FAIL with unopened-holdout proof when validation fails
